name: Fork-and-Merge Training with Linearized Branch
blurb: Fork-merge training loop: every 3N steps, run one normal DDP branch to θ₁, then a second branch from θ₀ following the 2nd-order Taylor surrogate of the loss around θ₁ (HVP via torch.func.jvp), and average. Research experiment, not a record attempt.
